mapper.select: SELECT b.BOOKS_ID, b.TITLE, b.AUTHOR, b.PUBLISHER, b.PUBLISHER, b.ISBN, b.CATEGORY, b.IMAGE_LINK, b.DESCRIPTION, b.CREATE_DATE, b.VIEW_COUNT, b.REVIEW_COUNT, b.LOAN_COUNT, b.LIKE_COUNT, b.STATUS, b.rnum FROM ( SELECT bk.BOOKS_ID, bk.TITLE, bk.AUTHOR, bk.PUBLISHER, bk.PUBLISHER, bk.ISBN, bk.CATEGORY, bk.IMAGE_LINK, bk.DESCRIPTION, bk.CREATE_DATE, bk.VIEW_COUNT, bk.REVIEW_COUNT, bk.LOAN_COUNT, bk.LIKE_COUNT, bk.STATUS, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM BOOKS bk ORDER BY bk.CREATE_DATE DESC ) a WHERE a.rnum > #{startRow} AND a.rnum <= #{endRow}

SELECT b.BOOKS_ID, b.TITLE, b.AUTHOR, b.PUBLISHER, b.PUBLISHER, b.ISBN, b.CATEGORY, b.IMAGE_LINK, b.DESCRIPTION, b.CREATE_DATE, b.VIEW_COUNT, b.REVIEW_COUNT, b.LOAN_COUNT, b.LIKE_COUNT, b.STATUS, b.rnum FROM ( SELECT bk.BOOKS_ID, bk.TITLE, bk.AUTHOR, bk.PUBLISHER, bk.PUBLISHER, bk.ISBN, bk.CATEGORY, bk.IMAGE_LINK, bk.DESCRIPTION, bk.CREATE_DATE, bk.VIEW_COUNT, bk.REVIEW_COUNT, bk.LOAN_COUNT, bk.LIKE_COUNT, bk.STATUS, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM BOOKS bk WHERE bk.CATEGORY LIKE CONCAT(#{category}, '%') AND bk.STATUS <> 1 ORDER BY ar.UPDATE_DATE DESC ) a WHERE a.rnum > #{startRow} AND a.rnum <= #{endRow}

SELECT b.BOOKS_ID, b.TITLE, b.AUTHOR, b.PUBLISHER, b.PUBLISHER, b.ISBN, b.CATEGORY, b.IMAGE_LINK, b.DESCRIPTION, b.CREATE_DATE, b.VIEW_COUNT, b.REVIEW_COUNT, b.LOAN_COUNT, b.LIKE_COUNT, b.STATUS, b.rnum FROM ( SELECT bk.BOOKS_ID, bk.TITLE, bk.AUTHOR, bk.PUBLISHER, bk.PUBLISHER, bk.ISBN, bk.CATEGORY, bk.IMAGE_LINK, bk.DESCRIPTION, bk.CREATE_DATE, bk.VIEW_COUNT, bk.REVIEW_COUNT, bk.LOAN_COUNT, bk.LIKE_COUNT, bk.STATUS, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM BOOKS bk WHERE 1 = 1 <if test="category != null and category != ''"> AND CATEGORY = #{category} </if> <choose> <when test="searchRequest.type == 'title'"> AND LOWER(TITLE) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{searchRequest.keyword}), '%') </when> <when test="searchRequest.type == 'author'"> AND LOWER(AUTHOR) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{searchRequest.keyword}), '%') </when> <when test="searchRequest.type == 'publisher'"> AND LOWER(PUBLISHER) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{searchRequest.keyword}), '%') </when> <when test="searchRequest.type == 'isbn'"> AND LOWER(ISBN) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{searchRequest.keyword}), '%') </when> <otherwise> AND 1 = 0 </otherwise> </choose> AND bk.STATUS <> 1 ORDER BY bk.UPDATE_DATE DESC ) b WHERE b.rnum > #{startRow} AND b.rnum <= #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOOKS WHERE CATEGORY LIKE CONCAT(#{category}, '%') AND STATUS <> 1

mapper.update: UPDATE BOOKS SET TITLE = #{title}, AUTHOR = #{author}, PUBLISHER = #{publisher}, PUBLISH_DATE = #{publishDate}, ISBN = #{isbn}, CATEGORY = #{category}, IMAGE_LINK = #{imageLink}, DESCRIPTION = #{description} WHERE BOOKS_ID = #{booksId}
